instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nexus Digital is a growing digital health platform focused on managing chronic conditions like diabetes and hypertension through connected device data. By integrating real-time glucometer and blood pressure readings with AI coaching, the company aims to improve patient adherence and clinical outcomes. Currently operating primarily in pilot phases across two key markets, they are heavily invested in developing predictive analytics to alert clinicians of potential health deterioration before critical events occur.
answers.pastInitiatives: We attempted to introduce a weekly innovation brainstorming session across departments, but attendance dropped rapidly after the first month. Participants felt the sessions generated interesting ideas but had no clear path to execution or budget. The initiative faded without producing any tangible outcome.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
answers.additionalContext: Nexus Digital currently faces significant internal friction regarding prioritizing features versus operational cost reduction. They lack formalized agile processes and robust clinical validation pipelines, making rapid iteration challenging.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Cost Optimization for Coaching Modules
opportunities.rationale: Leverage existing patient data to refine the AI coaching algorithms to prevent unnecessary high-touch clinical interventions or redundant reminders. This will directly improve efficiency by tailoring the intervention dosage based on predicted risk, which aligns perfectly with the strategic goal of margin improvement.

first_actions: Develop a focused MVP for risk stratification scoring in the AI engine
Secure internal clinical stakeholder buy-in via pilot data demonstrations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average patient intervention calls by 15% within 6 months
milestones: Q2: MVP completion and internal stress testing.
Q3: Pilot launch with 50 active patients.

opportunities.title: Automated Clinical Data Interoperability Layer (API Focus)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a standardized API layer to seamlessly integrate Nexus Digital's data with common Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems used by partner clinics. This eliminates manual data transfer and significantly reduces operational friction, which is a core efficiency driver.

first_actions: Identify top 3 target EHR integration partners
Define API specification requirements for HL7/FHIR standards compliance.
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful data exchange validation with 2 key partner clinics.
milestones: Q3: API specification finalized and development started.

opportunities.title: Micro-Device Partnership for Proactive Data Acquisition
opportunities.rationale: Explore a radical partnership with low-cost, wearable device manufacturers or specialized sensor providers to integrate passive data streams directly into the existing platform. This shifts the cost burden of capturing high-fidelity continuous data from internal development/hardware costs to an external partner, offering massive efficiency gains and rapid product expansion potential.

first_actions: Conduct a market scan for low-cost sensor OEMs
Draft a formal partnership proposal focusing on cost-sharing models.
execution_plan.success_metric: Securing MOUs with at least two external hardware partners.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated Innovation Steering Committee focused solely on efficiency metrics and ROI validation.
Conduct a talent gap assessment to identify critical skills needed for the AI optimization initiative and begin targeted upskilling/hiring.
Launch a lean, quarterly innovation sprint focused exclusively on validating 'quick win' incremental efficiency projects (e.g., API layer).

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation pipeline leading to sporadic and uncoordinated project efforts.
Critical talent gap in specialized data science skills required for advanced predictive modeling.
Low digital maturity (Level 1) resulting in technical debt that slows down rapid iteration required for 'bold' initiatives.
